educationalGoal: - To be able to build an edge computer consisting of a microcomputer, sensors, and actuators. - To be able to send the sensor values of edge computers to cloud computers via a network. - To be able to control the actuators of edge computers from cloud computers via the network.
advice: In this course, students will learn practical methods for building the basic systems necessary for realizing IoT using hardware and sensors. Students will learn the method of collecting and storing sensor values to cloud computers via a network using a microcomputer (Raspberry Pi) and various sensors, and learn how to analyze the stored data on cloud computers and output data from devices such as motors and small LED displays. Programming in C or Python language. The course flow of this subject is as follows. (1) Basic IoT system building - Exercises in building and networking an edge computer consisting of a microcomputer, sensors, and actuators. - Exercises in sending sensor information from an edge computer to a cloud computer via a network. - Exercises in controlling the actuators of edge computers from a cloud computer via a network. - Exercises in visualizing and analyzing sensor information stored in a cloud computer. (2) Advanced IoT system building - Free task: Students will plan and build an IoT system that solves a real-world problem and present it. In this course, no textbook is specified, but materials used in the class will be distributed.
requiredKnowledge: 1) Basic computer literacy (Windows and MS office operation, text editor operation, etc.). 2) Understand the basic elements of C or Python programming (conditional branching, iteration, functions, etc.). Students should have taken “Introduction to IoT Programming”or “Python Programming”or be equivalent to those. 3) Knowledge and experience with rudimentary Python programming and Linux programming is desirable.

activityGoals.body: To be able to build an edge computer consisting of a microcomputer, sensors, and actuators.
To be able to send the sensor values of an edge computer to a cloud computer via a network.

To be able to visualize and analyze sensor information stored in cloud computers.
